title: Clear product name buyers will see
category: e.g. packaging OR home OR personal-care OR other
shortDescription: 1–2 sentences. Specific claims only — no generic eco/green/sustainable.
bulletPoints: 3–5 bullets separated by | e.g. Recycled content certified|Plastic-free body
description: Longer product story for the listing. Still specific — no vague green fluff.
dimensions: e.g. 80 x 50 mm OR leave blank
publicClaims: Exact claim wording you allow KindNesta to publish
certNames: e.g. GRS|FSC OR leave blank if none
certNumbers: Matching cert numbers OR leave blank
certFileNames: PDF filenames you will attach OR leave blank
price: Trade unit price if sharing (private — not shown on site)
notes: Anything else KindNesta should know. Leave any column blank if it does not apply.
